rules.description: Some sketches report different constraint status between FreeCAD 0.19/0.20 and 1.2dev due to solver changes
Sketch solver status codes changed between FreeCAD 0.19/0.20 and 1.2dev
Sketch validity may change between FreeCAD versions due to solver and constraint engine changes
TechDraw template paths are absolute and include temp directories from the baseline generation environment
Volume computations may differ slightly between FreeCAD versions due to OCC kernel changes
Bounding box values may differ between FreeCAD versions due to geometry kernel changes
Bounding box values may differ between FreeCAD versions due to geometry kernel changes
ShapeString objects may produce solids in newer FreeCAD versions but not in the baseline version
Datum features may not be reported in newer FreeCAD versions due to macro changes
